release_notes: Build 111 adds a full Website inventory audit so current long-form Quiz History entries are compared directly with the Cloudflare catalogue.
Website now shows Local quizzes, On website and Missing counts alongside the existing schedule and question totals.
Missing local quizzes are shown first in the Website table and can be uploaded together with the new Sync missing action.
Sync missing only uploads quizzes absent from Cloudflare; website copies that already exist are left unchanged.
Saved YouTube schedule, upload and quiz creation dates are used to preserve sensible website release timing when a missing quiz is restored.
Quizzes that cannot be uploaded because a YouTube link, project folder, quiz.json or required question image is unavailable remain marked Missing and are reported for attention.
A missing row can also be synced individually with Sync selected, while existing website rows keep the Resync selected workflow.
Short-form Quiz History entries are excluded from the audit because the Factburst website catalogue is based on long-form YouTube quizzes.
Build 110 Create and Advanced cleanup, Build 109 day-to-day UI cleanup and the guided Needs You workflow remain included unchanged.
